name: Miwaku no Chousho
source:
The protagonist, a young man named Shinnosuke, discovers a beautiful mansion, in which apparently a large-scale party is taking place. Determined to meet and enchant some beautiful women, he ventures into the mansion.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/miwaku-no-chsho]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
主人公慎之介是一名年轻男子。他发现了一座美丽的宅邸，里面似乎正在举办一场盛大的聚会。为了结识美女并俘获她们的芳心，他毅然走进了宅邸。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/miwaku-no-chsho]Moby Games[/url]]
